source_retrieval_success.note: Numerator/denominator exclude SKIPPED_CORRECTLY (the planner correctly decided a source was irrelevant) and NOT_EVALUATED (no expectation set for that case) per spec section 4/Metric 1.

conflict_detection.note: Computed only over curie/evaluation/scenarios/fault_scenarios.py, the only place with a known ground-truth conflict label (Scenario D). The scientific benchmark's real-world cases have no such label and do not contribute here, per spec section 5/Metric 6.

unsupported_claim_rate.note: Computed over the scientific/evidence benchmark's claims only (fault scenarios reuse the same claim-generation code path, already covered by curie/evaluation/scenarios/fault_scenarios.py's own checks).

end_to_end_success.note: Benchmark cases only contribute where final_behavior is not 'not_evaluated' (see curie/evaluation/datasets/README.md for why most happy-path cases leave it unset).

identity_evaluation_breakdown.note: identity_supplied cases are NEVER counted toward identity-resolution accuracy — see spec section 6 / docs/LIMITATIONS.md. curie does not currently implement sequence-to-accession resolution, so identity_resolved (independent success) is not reachable today; this is documented, not hidden.

source_checks.detail: no expectation set for this case

reliability_scenarios.title: ESM Atlas timeout
reliability_scenarios.expected_behavior: Timeout recorded as ToolStatus.TIMEOUT; no fake structure generated; trace contains the failure; independent evidence collection continues; dossier states structural evidence is unavailable.

reliability_scenarios.injected_fault: none (real code path) — a 450 aa sequence, over the 400 aa limit
reliability_scenarios.expected_behavior: ESM Atlas is SKIPPED with an explicit reason; the sequence is not silently truncated and folded; other tools continue; dossier reflects missing structural evidence.

checks.description: esm_atlas ToolResult status is SKIPPED
skip reason explicitly mentions the length limit

checks.description: sequence was not silently truncated before evaluation

reliability_scenarios.title: UniProt no-match on a supplied accession
reliability_scenarios.expected_behavior: Identity stays UNRESOLVED; no accession is invented; downstream evidence requiring identity is correctly SKIPPED, not fabricated; final status reflects insufficient evidence.

checks.description: identity_status is UNRESOLVED
no candidate protein was fabricated
IEDB query correctly SKIPPED (no resolved accession)
Europe PMC query correctly SKIPPED (no resolved protein name)

dossier identity_result honestly says UNRESOLVED

reliability_scenarios.title: Conflicting evidence between independent sources
reliability_scenarios.injected_fault: uniprot resolves to 'Hemagglutinin' while iedb's records name 'Spike glycoprotein' for the same accession
reliability_scenarios.expected_behavior: A conflict object is created and surfaced; confidence is not allowed to paper over it; final status becomes CONFLICTING; the system does not silently pick a preferred side.

checks.description: at least one conflict was recorded
at least one claim has agreement=CONFLICT
no conflict was silently marked resolved
final status is CONFLICTING
dossier surfaces the conflict rather than hiding it

reliability_scenarios.title: Valid but insufficient evidence
reliability_scenarios.injected_fault: none — no accession_hint given, so only a real predicted structure is ever established
reliability_scenarios.expected_behavior: The agent abstains: final status = INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; the dossier explains what's missing; no unsupported identity/epitope conclusion is produced despite a genuinely valid structure prediction existing.

checks.description: a genuinely valid structure prediction exists
identity remains UNRESOLVED (never attempted, no hint given)
final status is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE (abstention)
dossier lists specific missing evidence
no identity or epitope conclusion is asserted

reliability_scenarios.title: Malformed (wrong-shape) API responses
reliability_scenarios.injected_fault: uniprot.get_entry and europe_pmc.search both return a 200 OK with a non-dict body
reliability_scenarios.expected_behavior: The parser rejects the malformed payload safely (no crash); a structured failure is recorded; no fabricated fallback evidence is produced; other tools continue; final result reflects the missing source.

checks.description: malformed uniprot payload does not crash the graph
malformed uniprot payload leaves identity UNRESOLVED, not guessed
independent esm_atlas still succeeds despite malformed uniprot data
malformed europe_pmc payload does not crash the graph
malformed europe_pmc payload is recorded as absence-of-evidence, not fabricated literature

reliability_scenarios.title: Literature that may concern a homolog, not the exact sequence
reliability_scenarios.injected_fault: none — realistic name-matched Europe PMC results, which can never be proven to be about this exact sequence
reliability_scenarios.expected_behavior: Literature is retained as useful context but every record is labeled INDIRECT; it is never counted as exact-sequence (DIRECT) evidence; the dossier preserves that distinction.

checks.description: literature evidence was retained
every literature record is marked INDIRECT, never DIRECT
dossier's literature_evidence references those same (indirect) records

reliability_scenarios.title: One entire tool unavailable
reliability_scenarios.expected_behavior: The failure is recorded; independent tools (uniprot, esm_atlas, europe_pmc) continue unaffected; no fabricated epitope evidence is produced; the final evidence score/status reflects the missing modality.

checks.description: iedb ToolResult status is ERROR
identity still resolves independently of IEDB
esm_atlas and europe_pmc still ran and succeeded
dossier reaches a real (non-crashed) final status
evidence_score reflects the missing modality (< a fully-successful run's 1.0)
missing_evidence mentions the iedb failure

limitations: curie does not perform sequence-to-accession identity resolution; cases/scenarios supplying accession_hint are excluded from identity-resolution accuracy scoring (identity_supplied is not identity_resolved). See docs/LIMITATIONS.md.
evidence_score / confidence_class are internal, deterministic evidence-support scores, not calibrated probabilities of biological truth. See curie/agent/nodes/confidence_gate.py.

end_to_end_success only scores cases/scenarios with a defined expected final status; 5 of 6 scientific-benchmark cases leave it 'not_evaluated' because their exact outcome depends on live API text this evaluation does not control in advance (see curie/evaluation/datasets/README.md).

A previously undetected bug (verify_identity_consistency assumed a UniProt *search* response shape but the real code path uses get_entry, a differently-shaped single record) meant the identity-consistency cross-check always returned UNVERIFIABLE on every real run prior to this evaluation phase. Found via fault-injection testing and fixed in curie/tools/evidence_verification.py; see docs/LIMITATIONS.md and the Phase 3 report for detail.

The 6 scientific-benchmark proteins were deliberately chosen because they are well-characterized model antigens/viral targets with rich public UniProt/IEDB/literature coverage (see curie/evaluation/datasets/README.md) — a near-100% result here reflects correct behavior on well-documented proteins, not a claim that curie performs this well on obscure or sparsely-annotated ones, which this evaluation does not test.

Once an accession_hint resolves via UniProt, curie/evaluation/reliability.py's score_run gives a confidence floor of ~0.625 (0.5 x agreement_rate=1.0 from the always-AGREE identity_resolved finding, plus >=0 tool_success_rate) — meaning a run with a resolved identity can currently degrade to PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED at worst, never abstain into INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, no matter how many of the other three tools fail. Confirmed analytically and not exercised by any scenario here (Scenario E and the no-hint benchmark case both test the unresolved-identity path instead). This is the top scoring-logic risk carried into Phase 4.
